title: Swin City Summer Pro League Returns To Dallas This Summer
htmlContent:
SwinCity is known for its high-end events creating the ultimate experience for the Dallas/Ft Worth basketball community.

Taking an outside-the-box mentality creatively and competitively makes SwinCity a place with players of all ages, men/boys and women/girls, competing in SwinCity’s Events. SwinCity is excited to go into our third year with our Summer Pro League.

When professional athletes return home, the Summer Pro League allows professional basketball
players from the NBA, G-League, Overseas and College players to hone on their skills during
the off-season.

“Giving our players a safe haven to work on their skills, while giving the community a chance to see players, family and friends at the same time,” said Tony Swindle Founder and Architect of SwinCity.

Players like Emmanuel Mudiay, BIG3s Isaiah Austin and Justin Dentmon, Overseas sensations Erick Neal, Antonius Cleveland, Jordan Mickey, Phil and Paul Pressey. On the women side Odyssey Simms, Alexus Jones, Andrea Riley, Akil Simpson, Jayla Johnson, Juicy Landrum, Bride Kennedy-Hopoate. As well as College players TCUs Big 12 All-American Mike Miles, SMUs Zurich Phelps and countless other pros.

SwinCity Summer Pro League is scheduled to take place June 17th through August 13th
Saturdays and Sundays at Hillcrest High School, Dallas, Tx.

There will be a total of sixteen men’s teams and 12 women’s teams this summer that will participate in SwinCity’s 3rd Annual Summer Pro League.SwinCity is an NBA/NCAA sanctioned basketball league in the DFW metroplex. Established in 2018 with a mission to build a platform to become what we are today, the staple in the DFW community bridging kids to college through athletic scholarships.

For more information Visit us at: www.swincityleague.com
